clock.description: the only clock in the design; one model step is one rising edge

description: Analyst-supplied security policy for the name-stripped secreg_blackbox fixture. Nothing in the netlist says which flip-flop is the lock or which four hold the secret; this file is the input that makes the question well posed, and it is the same list tools/hal_apb_recover produces when it recovers a register map from a netlist of this kind.

notes: No input is pinned quiescent: dbg_en in particular is left free, because an attacker who can reach the bus can reach it too, and pinning it would assume the defect away.

accesses.description: a bus write to slot 0, which engages the lock
a bus write to slot 1, the SECRET register
the second write path: a bus write to slot 2 with the debug enable asserted

external_write_controls.description: the pins an attacker with bus access can drive

lock.description: the lockdown bit at slot 0: written to 1 through the bus and cleared only by reset

name: secreg_blackbox
notes: SECRET is readable at slot 1 by design. Read-side confidentiality is not a property this analysis checks; see the declared exclusions.
